WHAT ARE FULL HEAD HIGHLIGHTS NYC? 

Our professional hairstylists offer customized full head highlights in NYC to help you achieve your desired hair color and dimension. Whether you're looking for same-day full highlights appointments or a trusted salon for full highlights in Manhattan, Luxe Aura Hair Extensions provides personalized services tailored to your hair type and goals. Contact us to schedule your appointment, subject to availability.

The full highlights process involves placing foils of lightener all throughout the head to achieve the level of blonde you desire. Depending on the type of hair length, texture, and density. you wonder


how long full highlights take at a salon?

Our hairstylists assess your hair's health, length, thickness, and texture to recommend the right level of lightness for your desired look. The time required for highlights depends on these factors and the complexity of the service. On average, a full head of highlights in NYC can take approximately 2–5 hours.


how much do full highlights cost NYC?

Our hairstylist will let you know what's best for the health of your hair and consider all the factors to determine the right lightness for you, however you should expect fees starting at $350 for full highlights in NYC.


how often you want to visit the salon for highlights retouching?

Full highlights entail lightened parts from the top of your head right down to the nape of your neck. By choosing the best stylists for full highlights in NYC the final results can be beautiful! After your appointment you can expect to return to the salon within 6 - 8 weeks, depending on hair growth and other maintenance factors.

Same-day full highlights appointments in NYC can be scheduled alongside same-day hair extension appointments at Luxe Aura Hair Extensions, subject to availability. Whether you're refreshing your hair color or combining highlights with extensions, our salon offers convenient appointment options. Contact us today to schedule your full highlights service in NYC.

items.title: What are full head highlights?
items.html: Full head highlights involve applying lightener with foils throughout the entire head to achieve an all-over brighter, dimensional look.

items.title: How long do full head highlights take?
items.html: A full highlights appointment typically takes 2 to 5 hours, depending on hair length, thickness, and desired results.

items.title: How much do full head highlights cost in NYC?
items.html: Prices generally start at around $350+, depending on hair type and level of lightening.

items.title: How often should I get full highlights touched up?
items.html: Most clients return for touch-ups every 6 to 8 weeks, depending on hair growth and maintenance.

items.title: Are full head highlights suitable for all hair types?
items.html: Yes, full highlights can be customized for different hair textures, lengths, and colors.

items.title: Do full head highlights include styling?
items.html: Yes, the service typically includes toning and a professional blow-dry finish.
